method: Stage 1: student pages 1-17 rendered at 2x and solved blind (review-scratch/c/BLIND_SOLUTIONS.md) before opening keys or level_c.py. Stage 2: key pages 18-22 and level_c.py find values compared item by item. Stage 3: text layer of all 22 pages, figure proportions measured on the renders, comparison with levels a and b of G9-KITE, ~/worksheet-work/kite-level-a, ~/worksheet-work/kite-smoke, G9-T15 (workspace/original/packages/G9-T15/final) and G9-T19 (batch-06), texts in review-scratch/c/cmp/.
maths_summary: All 72 keys agree with the blind solutions; every stored find value equals the printed key; units present; every proof/explain item has a reasoning line; no out-of-grade theorem (converse of Pythagoras, congruence, quadrilateral angle sum, area by diagonals, difference of squares only).

verdict_reason: The maths of all 72 items is correct and the print is clean. Nine questions (3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 9, 12, 14, 19) repeat a sibling level's or an earlier kite sheet's design or numbers in the same role, and q8 ד leaks the answer of q8 ג. The three writers worked in parallel and blind to each other, so the collisions are chance. The coordinator decides which level keeps each design; the fixes above are written for level c.

adjudications.didactic_REVIEWs: Level c has no didactic REVIEW: check_didactic PASS 92 FAIL 0 REVIEW 0. The six D4 REVIEWs (q1, q2, q7, q8, q12, q14) belong to level a, and its reviewer adjudicates them.

adjudications.scope_and_coverage: K01-K18 are all tested; proof and identification roles are real proofs. ★ on 14, 16, 20; 20 questions; calculator-free apart from q7 ג decimals, which C-03 removes. In scope: congruence, quadrilateral angle sum, Pythagoras and its converse, area by diagonals, algebra including difference of squares. The inclusive definition is in the opening box, and 'לא מעוין' is explicit where needed (q14 ד, q10 ג). Only convex kites, except the q12 ד non-example.
adjudications.printing: Grade label 'כיתה ט׳' on the header and subtitle. U+2212 throughout and no ASCII minus before a digit. No Hebrew parenthetical. No digit-bracket-digit reversal on student or key pages (the only hit, page 21, is the dropped radical in C-15). No '=' island between a unit and a number. Construction space is blank with no grid. Figures were measured on the renders against their data: q3 angles 80/40/120, q4 9:16 and 12, q8 21:48 and 40:69, q9 AO:AC = 1:8, q14 right kite 5-12-13 and LN-kite 3 : 8√2, q15 50°/110°, q17 9:12 with BP = 4.5, q18 EBCD a rhombus, q20 24:21. All match, and no figure marks a result before it is proven (right-angle marks only where given: q4 BH⊥CD, q5, q8 WXYZ, q14 ∠ABC, q16, q17).
